claims: As of April 2026, the NFL is in its off-season.
The full 2026 NFL schedule is set for release in May 2026.
2026 NFL preseason action begins in August 2026.
The 2026 NFL regular season starts in September 2026.
The Hall of Fame game occurs July 31–Aug 6, 2026.
2026 NFL preseason Week 1 games are scheduled Aug 7-13, 2026.
2026 NFL regular season Week 1 games are scheduled for Sep 4-9, 2026.
A Friday game in Australia between the San Francisco 49ers and the Los Angeles Rams is scheduled for the 2026 NFL season.
